Name: Ryoji Mochizuki - Persona 3 NPC Companion and Combat System
Author: ZeroVPN
Description:
# Ryoji Mochizuki - Persona 3 Custom NPC Mod

Bring Ryoji Mochizuki from Persona 3 into Stardew Valley as a fully featured custom NPC.

This mod adds Ryoji as a new character with friendship events, unique dialogue, companion features, combat abilities, and a custom skill progression system.

## Features

- New NPC: Ryoji Mochizuki
- Custom friendship events and heart events
- Custom dialogue and character interactions
- Companion system: Ryoji can accompany the player
- Combat system with unique skills and abilities
- Level progression and stat growth
- Custom Arcana skill system
- New UI pages for skills and progression
- Custom animations and visual effects

## Gameplay

Ryoji is not just a new  romanceable villager. He can participate in gameplay beyond daily interactions.

Develop your bond with him, unlock new abilities, and bring him into combat with his own progression system.

## Requirements

- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

## Installation

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and install the required dependencies.
3. Put the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

## Credits

Persona 3 and Ryoji Mochizuki belong to Atlus.

This is a fan-made mod created for Stardew Valley.
